newsitem.title: USA: Oncogene, Novartis TGF-Beta 3 in Phase II.
newsitem.headline: Oncogene, Novartis TGF-Beta 3 in Phase II.

text.p: Oncogene Science Inc said on Tuesday its collaborative partner Novartis Pharma AG started Phase II clinical trials in Europe, South America and the United States for its drug to prevent oral mucositis in cancer patients undergoing chemotherapy.
The drug, TGF-Beta 3, is a recombinant form of a naturally occurring protein. Oncogene discovered it and Novartis was developing it for two applications, Oncogene said.
Oral mucosis is a painful condition characterized by mouth and throat legions which occured when chemotherapeutic agents also attacked normal epithelial cells.
TGF-Beta 3 was being developed as a topical formulation to temporarily inhibit the high proliferation growth rate of certain normal cells in the mouth, Oncogene said.
The company said about 40 percent of chemotherapy patients exihibit some degree of oral mucositis.
Novartis was also developing TGF-Beta 3 to treat chronic skin wounds, like ulcers and pressure sores, Oncogene said.
